# #3573: Patch: Stinkyscape+ R, the release
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). **The release**: the set ships, players can play it against each other, and the AI deals itself none of it.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP8, SP9); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on `main` once the foundation (#3535) merges. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

## Scope

- Turn the set's row to `stage: Shipped` (R1420), and add `SetName::StinkyscapePlus` to `AI_DECK_GATED_SETS` (`crates/ai/src/config.rs`, R1390), so the AI's randomized decks deal none of it while players' do.
- **Turn on E9's unique random draws**: set `UNIQUE_RANDOM_DRAWS` to `true` in `crates/engine/src/config.rs`. E9 (#3563) merged it off so that no shipped card played differently before the release. With it on, every random card in an effect is unique unless the pool runs out (the owner's system change of 2026-11-09).
- One pending fragment, from `cargo jackioh patches "Stinkyscape+" …`, claims every new entry and every shipped card that plays or reads differently: S01's patched cards (the Evasive and Frenzy migration and the Replenish wording among them), xxFreshJack (S17), and the unique draws as a rule (`--rule`). `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` holds it to them (R1370000). `patches ship` names the version after the merge (v0.6.0: a set that ships is a major).
- The server's migration seeds the set. The golden traces are re-blessed once, and the seed-pinned tests are re-pinned for the bigger pools and the unique draws. Every stated total moves (card counts in docs, the spec, READMEs, the census in `catalog check`).
- Every new prompt and card is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout (the fuzz gate). The AI may still face the set: a player's deck holds it, and the AI must answer every card.
- Each card's §8 row says what was built.

## Done when

- [ ] Stinkyscape+ is in `SHIPPED_SETS` and in `AI_DECK_GATED_SETS`, and `UNIQUE_RANDOM_DRAWS` is on.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `names --check`, `golden check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`, `gate` and `classify --base origin/main --claims` pass on this branch, as do `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`.
- [ ] A hotseat game in the browser can deck and play Stinkyscape+ cards on both sides (a screenshot in a comment on this issue).
